entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Huh, you seem surprisingly calm.[n]I thought you'd be more panicked.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There're no customers.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Yooooo.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We're here!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Eep!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Sorry we're late. We were out buying stuff[n]and I got a little caught up in what to get.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: So many snacks... What exactly do you[n]plan on doing!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Well, summer vacation's the time when[n]you lounge around in your room all day.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, and eating snacks is the best part[n]of that!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You're gonna get fat, y'know.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Shut it!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hey, where's Futaba?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You have done well in coming here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wh-Whoa!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Shit freaked me out... That you, Futaba?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yup. Welcome.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Why are you wearing that?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Habit.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Anyway, bring it!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Not sure I get it... but let's do this!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Sheesh. Looks like today's going to be[n]another noisy day...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: For real, it was freakin' amazing![n]There were girls all over me!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Wait. You don't believe a word[n]I'm sayin', do ya?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Uh, it's you we're talking about here.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: There's no way you were ever a chick[n]magnet.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: What was that?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Agreed. As a member of the opposite[n]sex, I sense no charm from you, Ryuji.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Plus, popular guys wouldn't go bragging[n]about that stuff to other people.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: I keep wondering if I should do it while[n]I'm still young... but the dresses show[n]a lot of skin, right?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: ...Hey, are you even listening!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: There's no point talkin' about wedding[n]dresses right now. None of us have[n]significant others.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yep. I'm not getting married anytime soon.

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Can we please talk about something[n]else!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Y'know, Futaba's fine havin'[n]conversations.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Yeah, she doesn't have any trouble[n]speaking her mind.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Seems totally normal to me.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I dunno what normal is...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: But if this is it, I'm happy.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I totally thought you were gonna be[n]some weirdo, but I guess all that worryin'[n]was for nothing.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Mm-hm, I'm relieved too. I think things[n]should keep going smoothly at this rate.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: By the way, what's on the agenda for[n]tomorrow?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: How about we have her try helping[n]around the café?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: That's perfect!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: It'll be good practice to have her up[n]in front of strangers.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Eep...! Nope, nope, nope! Showing up[n]in the shop at lunchtime'll be like,[n]super-crushing hard mode!

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You don't have to deal with customers[n]if you don't want to. Maybe you could[n]dry plates in the back?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hrgh... Nrghhh...
Won't you help me?
I'll be there too.
Don't push yourself.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hrngh... Okay.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: ...I'd be mad if you weren't.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I-I can do it... I'll show you!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Then it's all set. We'll be rootin' for you,[n]Futaba!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Grrrr... You're all gonna pay for this[n]someday...
